subject: Readout runbook + calendar orchestration for latency results
messages:
From: Anya Petrov <anya.petrov@acme-robotics.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ryan Klein <ryan.klein@acme-robotics.com>, security@acme-robotics.com
Date: 2026-11-22T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: latency readout + artifacts (next week)

Jonas,

Thanks again for running the pilot last week. The team on our side would like a formal readout of the latency results and a short walk-through of the runbook you used to produce them. Key goals:
- Validate p50/p95 numbers across our two workload profiles
- See the KV cache behavior and any warmup artifacts
- Confirm what evidence you can share (raw traces, perf CSVs, dashboards) for our security and procurement teams

Participants: Lead SWE (me), Platform Eng (Ryan), Security mailbox, Procurement (Marco -- cc'd on logistics later).

Can you propose 2x 60-minute slots next week (preferably Tue/Wed afternoon PST)? We also need the readout recorded and the artifacts uploaded to our shared Drive.

Best,
Anya
Lead SWE, Acme Robotics
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anya Petrov <anya.petrov@acme-robotics.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T08:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: latency readout + artifacts (next week)

Anya — thanks for the clear ask. We can run a 60-minute readout that covers methodology, raw evidence, and an action-oriented runbook for next steps. Proposed slots (PST):

• Tue 2026-11-24, 2:00–3:00 PM
• Wed 2026-11-25, 3:30–4:30 PM

SoojIN (our SE) will lead the technical walkthrough and I’ll handle the commercial/rollout questions. Laura will join for any SLA/contract discussions.

Two quick asks from our side to make the session productive:
1) Can your team confirm which workload profile ("batch inference" vs "interactive routing") you want prioritized?
2) Please share any redaction or NDAs needed before we attach traces. We can provide a runbook PDF and the CSV summary in advance.

I’ve attached a draft runbook and a short p95 CSV (placeholder) to this reply.

Thanks — if those slots work I’ll send a calendar invite and a shared Drive folder link.

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
From: Anya Petrov <anya.petrov@acme-robotics.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ryan Klein <ryan.klein@acme-robotics.com>, Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@acme-robotics.com>, security@acme-robotics.com
Date: 2026-11-24T10:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: latency readout + artifacts (next week)

Jonas — thanks, appreciate the options. A couple of constraints on our side:
- Procurement (Marco) has an internal approval meeting on 11/24 that could block Tue afternoon.
- Security asks for SC-1 (SOC 2 snapshot) and a short data-flow diagram before they join. Can you confirm whether you can share the SOC 2 evidence or a redacted snapshot?

Given that, Wed 3:30–4:30 PM PST would be safest. Also, can you add a brief 10-minute slot at the end for procurement to confirm commercial terms? Marco will be dialed in from Mexico.

If you can upload the runbook and the p95 CSV to our shared Drive by EOD Tuesday, security will start the review.

—Anya
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anya Petrov <anya.petrov@acme-robotics.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, security@acme-robotics.com
Date: 2026-11-25T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: latency readout + artifacts (next week)

Thanks Anya — I’ll run the technical section. A couple of items I’ll bring and what I need from you:

We will present:
- p50/p95 by workload, warm/cold runs
- KV cache hit-rate graphs (5-minute granularity)
- Example raw trace (redacted IPs) + guidance on what to expect in our hosted vs. dedicated modes
Requests for your team:
- Confirm the two workload names you want (so we label slides correctly)
- If Security wants a redacted SOC 2 snapshot, please point me to a contact or upload a short request doc; we can provide SOC 2 section summaries for evidence but not full audit reports without an NDA/DSA in place.

Attachments in this thread: rdw_latency_readout_runbook_v1.pdf (runbook), latency_p95_summary.csv (p95 table). I’ll also prepare a short deck for the meeting and upload slides to the Drive link Jonas shared.

SoojIN
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@acme-robotics.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Anya Petrov <anya.petrov@acme-robotics.com>
Cc: Ryan Klein <ryan.klein@acme-robotics.com>, salesops@acme-robotics.com
Date: 2026-11-27T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: latency readout + artifacts (next week)

Folks — procurement here. We need a short commercial summary before the readout: list of SKUs/pricing model you used in the pilot, and an estimated cost delta to move to dedicated capacity (monthly). We also require a quote file and the redlined MSA template if applicable. Can you send these by Monday?

Also, due to timezone and exec review, can we move the readout to Mon 2026-11-30, 4:00–5:00 PM PST instead of Wed? That gives procurement time to review and means finance can join at the tail.

Marco Ruiz
Senior Procurement Manager, Acme Robotics
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anya Petrov <anya.petrov@acme-robotics.com>, Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@acme-robotics.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, security@acme-robotics.com
Date: 2026-11-30T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: latency readout + artifacts (next week)

Thanks all — confirmed for Mon 2026-11-30, 4:00–5:00 PM PST. Agenda (60m):

1) 4:00–4:05 — Quick intros / goals (Jonas)
2) 4:05–4:35 — Technical walkthrough: p50/p95, KV cache, traces (SoojIN)
3) 4:35–4:50 — Runbook & rollout guidance (Jonas + Soojin)
4) 4:50–5:00 — Procurement / next steps (Marco + Laura)

I’ve uploaded the runbook and the CSV to the shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C4d_readout_artifacts . Attached here are: rdw_latency_readout_runbook_v1.pdf, latency_p95_summary.csv, soc2_snapshot_request.docx (procurement/security template).

Commercial attachments (quote + pilot SKUs) will follow in a separate email; Laura will post the preliminary quote by EOD tomorrow. I’ll send the calendar invite with a Zoom link and enable recording.

If any change, reply-all and we’ll update. Looking forward to it.

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: rdw_latency_readout_runbook_v1.pdf (application/pdf), latency_p95_summary.csv (text/csv), soc2_snapshot_request.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
